title: Contact

time_created.description: Time the contact was added in Telerivet

time_updated.description: Time the contact was last updated in Telerivet

send_blocked.description: True if Telerivet is blocked from sending messages to this contact

conversation_status.description: Current status of the conversation with this contact

last_message_time.description: Last time the contact sent or received a message (null if no messages have been sent or received)

last_incoming_message_time.description: Last time a message was received from this contact

last_outgoing_message_time.description: Last time a message was sent to this contact

message_count.description: Total number of non-deleted messages sent to or received from this contact

incoming_message_count.description: Number of messages received from this contact

outgoing_message_count.description: Number of messages sent to this contact

last_message_id.description: ID of the last message sent to or received from this contact (null if no messages have been sent or received)

default_route_id.description: ID of the basic route (phone) or custom route that Telerivet will use by default to send messages to this contact (null if using project default route)

group_ids.description: List of IDs of groups that this contact belongs to

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this contact. Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

project_id.description: ID of the project this contact belongs to

url.description: URL to this contact in the Telerivet web app

description:
A contact represents a person or other entity that can be communicated with via phone number or other messaging channel within a project.

 Each contact has a name, phone number, and custom variables that can be used to personalize messages. Contacts can belong to one or more groups, and can be used as recipients for broadcasts, campaigns, and other messaging operations.

 Contacts can be imported or created individually via the API or web app. If the project's auto_create_contacts setting is enabled, a contact will be automatically created for each unique phone number that a message is sent to or received from.
